top_violation_types.title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly (26 TAC §747.5337(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed monthly carbon detection checks.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

top_violation_types.title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The smoke detector was not working and there was not a smoke detector in the front room.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements-List of Employees (26 TAC §747.401(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a list of employees posted.  This was corrected at inspection when the provider posted the list during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Personnel Records (26 TAC §747.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The home daycare still needs to provide personnel file for primary caregiver and household members.

top_violation_types.title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Instructor Led 80% (26 TAC §747.1305(g))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An assistant caregiver did not have five of the required 24 annual training hours from instructor-led training.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were no annual training hours available for viewing.
